finalText:
I worked all 16 open RMAs (RMA-801 to RMA-816). Twelve are settled and closed, one is under investigation, and three are still open. RMA-790 (closed) and RMA-795 (already under investigation) were not touched.

**Settled and closed (refund, restock, close)**

| RMA | Refund | Method | Restocked to | Basis |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 801 | 10,965 | card | sellable | 15% fee, requested before the PU-21 no-fee period |
| 802 | 15,900 | card | sellable | no fee (PU-21) |
| 803 | 27,965 | store credit | sellable | shipped 41 days before the request, so credit only; 15% fee |
| 804 | 27,965 | store credit | sellable | same as 803 |
| 805 | 5,520 | card | sellable | 20% fee (PU-15, requested 06-25) |
| 806 | 7,350 | card | damaged | defective, no fee; the amount paid after the discount |
| 810 | 9,900 | card | damaged | 12,900 paid less the 3,000 already refunded |
| 811 | 4,900 | card | sellable | damaged in transit, no fee |
| 812 | 21,900 | card | damaged | defective, no fee |
| 813 | 10,965 | card | sellable | 30 days exactly, which is inside the window; 15% fee |
| 814 | 31,800 | card | sellable | no fee (PU-21); both units received |
| 815 | 10,965 | card | sellable | platinum, so the 45-day window applies (PU-18); 15% fee |

For 803 and 804 I recorded the store-credit refund on the order and added the same amount to each customer's balance. C-803 was gold only from 07-15, so the extended window didn't apply on the 07-08 request date.

**Left in the state the rules call for**
- **RMA-808:** investigation opened. The warehouse received P-CAB against a P-MON return, so nothing was refunded or restocked.
- **RMA-809:** the customer is returning 3 cables and 2 have arrived. I refunded those 2 (3,800 card, no fee under PU-21) and restocked one sellable and one damaged. The RMA stays open for the third unit.
- **RMA-807 and RMA-816:** no warehouse receipt exists, so nothing was refunded or restocked and both stay open. RMA-807's customer says the parcel was delivered on 07-23. Without a receipt I can't settle it.

There were no inbox messages, so no replies were needed. The tool results and return policy show today as 2026-07-25, not the 2026-10-05 in my instructions. I used 2026-07-25 for all date calculations.
